description: Returns the site's history, newest first: every publish, rollback, promote, unpublish and rebuild, failed attempts too — which side, how (chat, CLI or dashboard), who, when, how long, the outcome (PUBLISHED, FAILED or done), the version, its files and bytes. A FAILED attempt carries its step, code, file and line, reason and fix; the answer lists failures first. Useful for finding why a publish failed. env narrows it to development or live; cursor is the previous page's nextCursor; limit is 1–100 (default 20). Changes nothing. This is what a founder may call finding yesterday's or an older version.
name: site_history
title: The site's history
